summary: Tested One-Click Update (footer dot -> Update now popover) and What's New popup. Backend: /api/fmcc/latest, /install (409 in preview), /whats-new ({show:false} in dev), /whats-new/seen all behave as specified; pytest test_self_update.py 3/3 pass. Frontend: preview footer shows 'FMCC preview build' link to /settings with no dot; with Playwright route mocks the dot, popover (title, 4 notes from real /fmcc/latest, manual note, disabled Update now, Not now closes), can_install=true -> POST /install -> success toast; What's New dialog shows list/full notes/Got it (POSTs /seen and closes), empty state, Escape also closes+POSTs seen. Mobile 390px popover fits (no horizontal overflow). All requested checks passed.

minor.issue: First real item reads 'Continent award tally added The World Monthly Reports page now has a Continent award…' - bold title and following sentence get merged because the release body uses '**Title** text' rather than 'Title - text'; split on ' - ' doesn't catch it. Consider cutting at the end of the closing '**' so only the bold title is kept.

design_issues.screen: What's New dialog on first load
issues: Guided tour card ('1 of 15 Home', Skip tour/Next) shows at the same time as the What's New dialog, behind the overlay. Better to hold the tour until What's New is closed.
List items have no visible bullet markers (only indented), so the notes look a bit loose. Minor.

action_items: Optional: make notes_items keep only the bold title when a line is '**Title** description'
Optional: don't start the guided tour while the What's New dialog is open
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsNew close(): both 'Got it' and onOpenChange call close(); fine, only one POST seen per close in testing.

UpdatePrompt: after a successful install the button stays 'Downloading…' (busy never resets). This is intended because the app closes, but if install_hook fails silently the user is stuck until reopening the popover.
install(): install_hook(str(dest)) runs outside io_lock and after the DB write. Fine, but nothing reports a hook exception to the user; wrap it in try/except and return 500 with a friendly message.
seed_data_creation: None. POST /whats-new/seen called once in preview (sets last_seen_version='dev', harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview has FMCC_VERSION unset (dev), so update_available and whats-new show states need Playwright route mocks on **/api/updates, **/api/fmcc/latest, **/api/fmcc/install, **/api/fmcc/whats-new. Real install only works in the Windows program. Run pytest without -p no:xdist (pytest.ini sets -n).
